title: Theories of consciousness move in an epistemological circle

statements.text: Judgments about how widespread sentience is rest on starting assumptions about sentience itself, so theorizing about consciousness occupies an apparently unavoidable epistemological circle. On the enactive view this calls for a transcendental perspective and, possibly, a participatory epistemology using phenomenological methods.

sources.quote: we occupy an apparently unavoidable epistemological circle in theorizing about consciousness
